response.sql: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) as avg_price FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), overall_avg_val AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) as overall_average FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL), above_overall AS (SELECT ta.production_type_code, ta.avg_price FROM type_averages ta WHERE ta.avg_price > (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg_val)), kept_mean_val AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) as kept_mean FROM above_overall), final_kept AS (SELECT ao.production_type_code, ao.avg_price FROM above_overall ao WHERE ao.avg_price > (SELECT kept_mean FROM kept_mean_val)) SELECT AVG(avg_price) as type_average_price, AVG(avg_price - (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg_val)) as distance_above_overall, AVG(avg_price - (SELECT kept_mean FROM kept_mean_val)) as distance_above_final_mean FROM final_kept
